newsitem.title: UK: Ionica tracks down international MD at EBRD.
newsitem.headline: Ionica tracks down international MD at EBRD.

text.p: British telephone technology and network company Ionica said on Wednesday it had hired Edouard Wylleman to be managing director of its international business.

Wylleman joins the privately-owned company from the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and group chief executive Nigel Playford said in a statement that he would help the company in its efforts to realise the international potential of its so-called Fixed Radio Access telephony system.
"We are confident that Fixed Radio Access is the key to competing in many other developed and developing markets around the world," Playford said.
